question: Please group all Italian customers into ten buckets for December 2021 by summing their profits from all products purchased (where profit is calculated as quantity_sold multiplied by the difference between unit_price and unit_cost), then divide the overall range of total monthly profits into ten equal intervals. For each bucket, provide the number of customers, and identify the minimum and maximum total profits within that bucket.
sql:
WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(s.quantity_sold * (co.unit_price - co.unit_cost)) as total_profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN costs co ON s.prod_id = co.prod_id AND s.time_id = co.time_id
  JOIN countries ctry ON c.country_id = ctry.country_id
  WHERE ctry.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND s.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
range_info AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_val, MAX(total_profit) as max_val
  FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
         CAST(
           CASE
             WHEN cp.total_profit = ri.max_val THEN 10
             ELSE FLOOR((cp.total_profit - ri.min_val) / ((ri.max_val - ri.min_val) / 10.0)) + 1
           END AS INTEGER
         ) as bucket
  FROM customer_profits cp, range_info ri
)
SELECT b.bucket,
       COUNT(bp.cust_id) as num_customers,
       ROUND(MIN(bp.total_profit), 2) as min_profit,
       ROUND(MAX(bp.total_profit), 2) as max_profit
FROM (SELECT 1 as bucket UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) b
LEFT JOIN bucketed bp ON b.bucket = bp.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket
ORDER BY b.bucket
